shadows.name: dialog-separation
shadows.purpose: Modal dialogs that suspend the instrument.

components.name: Mode Tab
components.description: Workspace tab in the sticky mode bar.
components.css: .ds-mode-tab { appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--ink-faint, #737373); font-family: var(--font, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.035em; min-height: 36px; padding: 9px 0; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mode-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); } .ds-mode-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #f2f2f2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-mode-tab-active { color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); border-bottom-color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); }

components.name: Section Header
components.css: .ds-section-header { width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; appearance: none; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline, #242424); color: var(--ink-dim, #a3a3a3); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; padding: 12px 12px 9px; text-align: left; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-section-header:hover { color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); } .ds-section-header:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #f2f2f2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-caret { color: var(--ink-faint, #737373); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button { background: var(--panel-2, #0d0d0d); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #242424); color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; padding: 6px 8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-button:hover { border-color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ink, #f2f2f2); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(242, 242, 242, 0.07); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Mono field for values and expressions.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--panel-2, #0d0d0d); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #242424); color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); font-family: var(--mono, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace); font-size: 10px; padding: 6px 7px; outline: none; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-faint, #737373); }

components.name: Preset Row
components.description: Preset browser row with thumbnail and metadata.
components.css: .ds-preset { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 44px minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-left: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--ink-dim, #a3a3a3); cursor: pointer; padding: 5px 4px 5px 6px; text-align: left; } .ds-preset:hover { background: var(--panel-2, #0d0d0d); color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); } .ds-preset:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--swiss-red, #e30613); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-preset-thumb { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0a0a0a; border: 1px solid #141414; color: var(--ink-faint, #737373); font-family: var(--mono, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace); } .ds-preset-copy { display: grid; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .ds-preset-copy strong { font-family: var(--font, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-preset-copy small { color: var(--ink-faint, #737373); font-family: var(--mono, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace); font-size: 8px; line-height: 1.35; }

components.name: Layer Row
components.description: Inset row for selecting and acting on a layer.
components.css: .ds-layer-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 18px 18px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: #080808; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #242424); color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); padding: 4px 5px; font-family: var(--mono, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace); font-size: 9px; } .ds-layer-row.active { border-color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); } .ds-layer-name { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Rectangular modal surface with deep separation.
components.html:
EDIT LAYER
Rename the active layer.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(360px, calc(100vw - 32px)); background: #080808; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #242424); box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65); padding: 16px; font-family: var(--mono, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace); color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); } .ds-dialog-title { color: var(--ink-dim, #a3a3a3); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; margin-bottom: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-dialog-copy { font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-dialog-input { width: 100%; background: var(--panel-2, #0d0d0d); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #242424); color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); font-family: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 8px; outline: none; } .ds-dialog-input:focus { border-color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); } .ds-dialog-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 6px; margin-top: 14px; } .ds-dialog-cancel, .ds-dialog-confirm { background: var(--panel-2, #0d0d0d); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #242424); color: var(--ink, #f2f2f2); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; padding: 6px 8px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-dialog-confirm { border-color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); color: var(--swiss-red, #e30613); }

narrative.overview: Parametrica looks like a precision instrument that happens to be software: a black stage, a narrow measurement rail, hairline separators and one red signal. The canvas is the work; the panel is the console. Nothing is decorated unless it helps the user read a value, a state or a hierarchy. The system is flat by default. Depth comes from tonal steps and 1px hairlines, not from cards floating over the page. Red is rare and operational: it marks the active mode, the focused edge, an error or a destructive state. Large red surfaces are a failure of the language.
keyCharacteristics: Carbon-black field with near-black instrument panels.
Functional sans for labels, mono for data and expressions.
One Swiss red signal, used sparingly.
Dense but legible: 11px functional text and compact 36px mode tabs.
The canvas remains visually dominant at every breakpoint.

rules.name: The Red Signal Rule
rules.body: Red occupies less than 10% of any screen. It marks state and attention; it never fills a panel, a card or a large button face.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure comes from 1px lines and tonal steps. If a group can be separated with a hairline, do not add a shadow or a filled card.

rules.name: The Functional Type Rule
rules.body: No serif, display script or decorative face. If the text is data, it is mono; if it is a control label, it is sans and compact.

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional text stays at 11px or larger where the layout allows. Do not shrink labels to make room for decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No card shadows, no hover lift, no glass panels. State changes are borders, color and focus outlines.

rules.name: The Overlay Exception
rules.body: Shadows are allowed only when a dialog or overlay must detach from the full-screen instrument.

dos: Do keep the canvas black and visually dominant.
Do use Swiss red for state, focus, error and one clear active accent.
Do separate groups with hairlines and tonal steps.
Do use mono for values, expressions, telemetry and IDs.
Do preserve keyboard focus, reduced motion and 200% zoom behavior.
Do keep controls compact and functional; density is part of the identity.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent color or a gradient background.
Don't round cards, buttons or panels; radius is 0.
Don't add card shadows, hover lift or glassmorphism.
Don't fill large areas with Swiss red.
Don't use decorative serif or display faces.
Don't hide the canvas behind chrome or oversized empty states.
Don't lower functional text below 11px to create breathing room.
Don't invent testimonials, metrics or fabrication claims in UI copy.
